Description: Use Permit to establish an approximately 54,600 square foot public safety facility for the Berkeley Fire Department and Emergency Operations Center in the six buildings bounded by Eighth Street, Gilman Street, and Ninth Street. The project includes: demolition of two accessory structures; conversion of 42,000 square feet to office and ancillary uses including, training facilities (17,200 square feet) and a staff wellness center (5,200 square feet); conversion to a non-emergency ambulance deployment center (7,400 square feet); and a warehouse (5,100 square feet).

Description: Yancey Alexander Holdings, LLC is a Black-owned luxury lifestyle and leisure holding company. The company is rooted in providing high-quality, home-oriented products under its "Alexander" brands and expanding into leisure, lifestyle, and third-place experiences under its "Yancey" brands. The business will initially focus on launching Alexander Homebody, a candle company based in Berkeley, California, that will expand into home goods and decor before introducing leisure experiences. During the initial iteration of the business, the 3138 California St residence is where the founder will be melting wax, mixing in fragrance oil, and pouring wax.
